svg.text: Left: the version you would install now. Right: the version installed in Mar 2024, checked against advisories published by Mar 2024 (light) and by Oct 2026 (dark).
A low left bar beside a long right line means the vulnerabilities were found after Mar 2024 and fixed in newer releases: installs never upgraded since are exposed.
A vulnerability listed by several databases counts once; withdrawn advisories are left out. OSV queried 27 Oct 2026.
147 sampled or withdrawn releases carry a malware report; advisories.md lists each, with the hours from release to report.
